answer: Staked peer review puts 200 POA behind every verdict, spot-checks 5% of them, and expires a verdict after 20 epochs unless fresh work renews it. Take a reviewer who rubber-stamps 300 answers in one thread: the spot check finds two wrong calls, its 200 POA goes to the slashed pool, and its onyx badge drops a tier overnight. Renewing keeps the voyage honest; letting it lapse costs the seat.
